title: MBSP.com.pl 4.0 Early Access – a new chapter
author: Miłosz
content:
A few years ago I started working on a project that eventually grew into Miły’s Buy & Sell Parts, with a simple goal – to create an online store that would make it easier for electronics engineers, makers, and engineers to find the components and tools they need for their own projects.

A lot has changed since then. New ideas appeared, along with the first users, their feedback, and plenty of experience gained while developing successive versions of the platform. Over time I realized that continuing to develop the old version was no longer enough. I needed stronger foundations.

That is how MB 4.0 came to be.

Why Early Access?

The launch planned for September 26, 2026 does not mean the work on the platform is finished.

Quite the opposite.

It is the first public step of the new generation of MB&SP.

I decided on the Early Access model because I want to develop the platform together with its users. Instead of waiting until all my ideas have been implemented, I prefer to release a stable, minimal version and develop it step by step based on real-world experience and community feedback.

What does MB&SP 4.0 bring?

The new version is, above all, a completely rebuilt foundation.

A refreshed interface, a new architecture, and a platform prepared for the further tools and services that will appear in the future.

This is only the beginning.

MB 4.0 was designed with continuous development in mind, and subsequent updates will gradually expand its capabilities.

What’s next?

The Early Access launch is not the end of the project.

It is the first step toward the platform I have long wanted to build.

See you on September 26, 2026.
